messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: page fired for service=runtime.latency.p99 region=us-west - threshold=3000ms over 5m (count=120). Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC12345

mike_oncall: ack. I'm on it. pinging infra + ml.

alex: I'm pulling dashboards. Seen a steady p99 climb starting ~10:42 UTC, spike at 10:51. Tokenizer queue depth increased.

priya: confirming - tokenizer-sidecar backlog up x10 on a subset of pods (north-az). Could be a network hiccup or head-of-line.

alex: running quick check:
```
kubectl get pods -n runtime -l app=tokenizer -o wide
# sample output
# tokenizer-5f9d8  2/2  Running  120Mi  node-us-west-2a
# tokenizer-7b3c1  1/2  CrashLoopBackOff  200Mi  node-us-west-2b
```

mike_oncall: CrashLoopBackOff on tokenizer-7b3c1 - that aligns with partial region degradation. Priya, can we restart that pod and tail logs?

priya: restarting now. tailing logs...

priya: logs show repeated TLS handshake timeouts to kv-cache endpoint (10.10.4.22). Intermittent network errors.

sarah: routing policy allows fallthrough to dedicated capacity. Suggest temporary reroute traffic for the affected AZ to dedicated-pool-us-west while we investigate. Low-risk.

mike_oncall: do it. alex - can you flip the route?

alex: flipping route -> `POST /api/v1/routing/override` with body: `{ "region":"us-west","target":"dedicated-pool-us-west","reason":"p99 spike tokenizers AZ-b" }`

alex: done. rolling traffic now, ~30% shifted in 90s. observing metrics...

incident-bot: Routing override applied by alex (link: https://console.redwood/routing/override/abc123)

josh: ack on pager (taking escalation). I'll keep PD on the loop and notify SRE rotation.

pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by josh@redwood (PagerDuty). Escalation chain notified.

priya: restarted tokenizer pod. TLS timeouts dropped after kv-cache pod restart on node 10.10.4.22. Looks like transient KV-side instability.

mike_oncall: great. can we confirm p99 back under target for 10m window?

alex: p99 has dropped from ~3.4s to 1.1s after reroute + kv restart. Monitoring for sustained recovery.

sarah: TG: customers with heavy streaming (CustomerA, CustomerC) had increased error latency but no 5xx escalation yet. Recommend outbound customer comms if not stable in 30m.

mike_oncall: noted. I'll open an incident ticket and tag customer-success. Creating INC-2023-042 in tracker.

priya: adding follow-up action: investigate root cause of kv-side pod socket exhaustion; maybe increase keepalive or drain schedule.

alex: adding config tweak suggestion to runbook: bump kv proxy connection pool from 100 -> 200 for warmup window.

mike_oncall: plan: 1) keep routing override until stable 15m, 2) runbook action for kv proxy, 3) postmortem if we see recurrence.

josh: leaving PD acknowledged. I'll hand back to oncall once we've passed 30m stable.

mike_oncall: oncall signoff when p99 < 1.2s for 15m and no new PD pages. Continuing watch. :eyes:

incident-bot: Note added to incident INC-2023-042 by mike_oncall: "temporary routing override to dedicated-pool-us-west applied; kv-cache pod restart; monitoring"

mike_oncall: closing thread for now, will update incident doc with metrics + timeline. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
